text:
maya (design): quick sync — sketched a keyboard-first flow for the canary inspector, want eyes.
sam (product): dropping the PNGs in the thread, TY. what's the intent? keyboard users should be able to open inspector and scrub versions without a mouse?
maya (design): exactly. current flow expects mouse to click the micro-timeline. proposed: focus lands on the inspector toggle, Enter opens, then left/right arrow steps versions, space toggles details panel.
lina (design): love that. can we avoid arrow conflicts with the timeline scrubber? arrows are overloaded.
jordan (a11y): arrows can be fine if we manage aria-roledescription and focus trapping. also need an announcement when user reaches a snapshot that has a rollback safeguard.
devan (eng): implementation wise we can wire keyboard handlers on the focused element. worried about interfering with global shortcuts (e.g., / for search). need to namespace handlers.
sam (product): microcopy question: the primary action currently reads "Rollback to this version" — some PMs want "Restore" to avoid panic. thoughts?
maya (design): "Rollback" is clearer for engineers; "Restore" feels softer for product managers. maybe use "Restore (rollback)"? feels clunky.
jordan (a11y): whichever label we pick, add an aria-describedby that explains what happens (data rollback, traffic changes). screen reader users need the consequences.
lina (design): alternative: primary CTA "Go back to this version" and secondary "Open diff". long but more explicit.
sam (product): prefer short and scannable. could surface an inline help icon that opens a short tooltip paragraph about what rollback does.
maya (design): tooltip + aria-describedby would cover both. tooltip content should be subtle: "Sets active variant to this snapshot and re-routes traffic according to selected allocation. This is reversible." short.
jordan (a11y): phrase "This is reversible" is dangerous — we should say "You can undo this in version history" and ensure undo affordance exists.
devan (eng): on undo: we already have a rewind API but UX needs a clear path. if we show a toast with an "Undo" button, is that sufficient accessibility-wise?
jordan (a11y): toast must be focusable and persistent enough for screen reader users. use role="alertdialog" with focus on the Undo button when possible.
maya (design): noted. also thinking about the timeline compact mode: when space is constrained we collapse micro-timeline to a left/right comb with counts. keyboard users must still be able to get full timeline with a "Show full timeline" control.
lina (design): UI nit: when the inspector opens, focus currently jumps to the top of the panel. that loses context. propose focus stays on the version you opened from and then moves into panel details on Tab.
sam (product): good catch. that aligns with user's mental model — they opened inspector to act on a specific version.
devan (eng): one more tech note: continuous batching UI update could cause focus jumps when live traffic numbers update. we need to snapshot DOM while inspector is open or debounce updates.
maya (design): agreed — add a "live" badge and pause updates when inspector modal open. show a small "live updates paused" indicator.
jordan (a11y): aria-live region should still announce significant state changes even when paused — e.g., if a deployment fails during the pause, it should announce.
maya (design): on canary allocation slider: current labels "10%/50%/100%" are clickable but small target. increase touch target and add visible focus ring. Also add a keyboard modifier to nudge by 1% (Shift + Arrow).
lina (design): plus one for the focus ring. also please ensure contrast of the slider handle meets 4.5:1 when selected.
sam (product): quick decision: change CTA label to "Rollback" but add tooltip and aria-describedby as discussed. ok?
maya (design): I'm fine with that — will update comps.
jordan (a11y): I can draft the aria-describedby copy and examples. will paste later.
devan (eng): I'll scope the handlers, debounce, and toast undo behavior. estimate 2 dev days + 1 day a11y tweaks.
maya (design): action items: 1) maya update comps with keyboard flow + tooltip 2) jordan paste aria copy 3) devan spike handlers & toast behavior 4) lina QA contrast/focus tweaks. ping me when done.
sam (product): thanks everyone. small UX litmus test: can we run this with a keyboard-only user for 15 minutes in research next week?
maya (design): scheduling now. @recruiting can you invite a keyboard-only tester next Wed? :pray:
